text.title: Error Handling (RFC 7807 Problem Details) — Worked Example
text.summary: One end-to-end worked example of the procedure, followed by three framework reference implementations of the handler and the reusable contract test.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: Django REST Framework service exposes `/v1/orders`; needs RFC 7807 envelope for 4xx/5xx with traceId from OpenTelemetry. Owner: tl:alex; reviewer: tl:bob; cadence: per-release.

list.item: Each prerequisite supplied per the AGENTS.md table; sources linked.
Existing artefact catalogue checked for duplicates (none found).

section.title: Walkthrough
section.p: The team runs the five-step procedure in `content/04-procedure.xml`, recording one paragraph per step. At step 4 the self-check triggers a fix on the rationale (no input cited); re-check passes. The artefact emits with status='ready-for-owner-review'.

list.item: The decision tree in `content/06-decision-tree.xml` saved one round at step 1 by ruling out a duplicate artefact.
Without the self-check at step 4 the rationale would have shipped without input citations.

example.note: 5xx detail is static — no exc.__str__. traceId propagated from W3C header.
One middleware handles everything. 5xx body is static.
Spring 6 provides ProblemDetail natively. APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON enforces +json content-type.

example.code:
import jsonschema, requests, yaml, pathlib
SCHEMA = yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path("templates/problem-details.schema.yaml").read_text())
def test_validation_error_envelope(): r = requests.post("http://localhost:8000/users", json={}) assert r.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/problem+json") assert r.status_code == 400 body = r.json() jsonschema.validate(body, SCHEMA) assert body["status"] == r.status_code
example.note: Reusable across endpoints. Asserts content-type, status range, schema, and status-match.
